jobs.title: Roof Age
jobs.description: Skip to content Roof Age You Can Trust. GeoX AI Roof Age reviews a property's dated imagery history, back to the mid-2000s with 8 to 27 frames per roof where available, to estimate when the roof was last replaced. Confidence-rated, evidence-backed, and independent of self-reported dates. Request a Demo See a Sample Report One roof. Years of evidence. A dated imagery sequence reveals when the replacement happened. Roof age is one of the most important roof risk factors - and one of the hardest to verify. Carriers rely on policyholder-reported roof age, which is frequently inaccurate or missing entirely. Tax records are often incomplete or out of date. Inspection programs don't scale. And a roof that's 5 years past its expected lifespan carries dramatically more risk than one that was replaced last year. Without evidence-backed roof age, you're pricing blind on one of the most material risk factors in your book. 8–27 dated images. One definitive answer. GeoX AI Roof Age analyzes a dated sequence of aerial imagery for each property - typically 8 to 27 images - to identify the exact point when a roof was last replaced. Advanced AI distinguishes full replacements from minor repairs, patches, and environmental noise. The result: a confidence-rated roof age estimate that underwriters can trust and defend. Why P&C carriers use AI-derived roof age Avoid Loss Identify properties approaching end-of-life before renewal. Flag high-risk roofs that self-reported data would miss. Improve Pricing Price accurately based on verified roof age rather than policyholder estimates. Reduce premium leakage on aging roofs. Defensible Decisions Every estimate is traceable to a specific imagery timeline. Underwriters can show exactly when the roof changed - not just a score. Increase Revenue Write more business with confidence. Get roof age at the point of quote, so you're not waiting on an inspection to underwrite. ALL 50 States Nationwide coverage 8–27 Images Per property analyzed Confidence-Rated Every estimate scored Dated Sequence Multi-year imagery timeline Where Roof Age makes the difference. Underwriting Verify roof age at point of quote. Stop relying on self-reported data that's frequently wrong or missing. Pricing & Rating Incorporate verified roof age into rating models. Differentiate a recently replaced roof from one with no replacement since the mid-2000s. Portfolio Analysis Assess roof age distribution across your entire book. Identify concentration of aging roofs by geography, vintage, or material type. Renewal See which roofs haven't been replaced in years, so reviewers know where to look first at renewal. Testing GeoX AI against another vendor showed a clear accuracy advantage, giving us the validation to move forward. Randall Graham Regional Underwriting Manager, SC Farm Bureau Frequently asked questions. How old is my roof? One reliable way to determine a roof's age without records is to analyze a dated sequence of aerial imagery of the property over time and identify the point at which the roof's material and structure changed. GeoX AI Roof Age automates this using up to 27 frames per roof, where available, and returns a confidence-rated estimate rather than a guess. How is roof age estimated from imagery? What's the difference between effective age and actual age? How to determine roof age without an inspection? Stop guessing. Start knowing. Evidence-backed, confidence-rated roof age for your residential book. Request a demo to see it on your properties. Request a demo Download sample data

jobs.title: Vacancy Score
jobs.description: Skip to content Get a Unique View Into Property Vacancy Assess property condition and risk with a Vacancy Score built on clear, verifiable signals of inactivity. Evaluate your properties Vacancy Score: a new standard in risk signals For the first time, vacancy is measurable. Powered by historical aerial and street-level imagery, our AI identifies concrete signs of inactivity and delivers a unique Vacancy Score. Identifying vacancy signals Vehicle absence Empty driveways or consistently missing cars. Yard neglect and debris Overgrown lawns, uncollected waste, visible clutter, and signs of unauthorized occupancy such as temporary shelters. Roof and structural damage Visible deterioration, leaks, or ongoing disrepair. Boarded or broken windows and doors Closures or damage that indicate abandonment. Graffiti and vandalism Clear visual evidence of neglect or long-term vacancy.

jobs.title: Global Partners
jobs.description: Skip to content Global Partners GeoX works with national data authorities and global data platforms to put AI-powered property intelligence where decisions are made. Talk to us Geoscape Australia In 2020, GeoX partnered with Geoscape Australia to enhance the country’s national geospatial datasets with AI-powered property intelligence. Through advanced machine vision and deep learning applied to aerial imagery, GeoX analyzed more than 18 million buildings across Australia, improving building outlines, height accuracy, parcel alignment, and property attributes such as solar panels and pools. Precisely In 2025, GeoX joined Precisely’s Data Link program, connecting its AI-powered property intelligence to Precisely’s global data ecosystem. By linking GeoX datasets with Precisely’s unique identifiers, the partnership eliminates the complexity of data stitching and gives insurers and enterprises faster access to enriched property insights.
